| MAT-T32 | 2026-10-22 | chore | open | Spike: set up SSO for the MindAttic Claude Team org so per-CLI logins stop needing an emailed code per sign-in. Findings so far: Team plans include SAML SSO and domain verification (no SCIM; users are created on first SSO sign-in), set up by an Owner/Primary Owner under Organization and access > Domains and Identity and access (Anthropic uses WorkOS). Nothing is installed on the mindattic.com website: verification is one TXT record at the domain root in GoDaddy DNS management (case-sensitive, shown once, 24-48h). Needs an identity provider; first find where @mindattic.com mail lives: Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 already is one (a GoDaddy-resold M365 tenant may need defederating first), otherwise add one (e.g. JumpCloud free tier). Assign every user to the Claude app in the IdP before enforcing SSO or they're locked out. Cheaper alternative to check first: 'Continue with Google' if the mailboxes are Google. Also confirm Anthropic's Team terms allow one person to use several seats. Once live, orchestrator login --account <email> --sso already forces the SSO flow. Refs: support.claude.com/en/articles/13132885-set-up-single-sign-on-sso | — |
